profile.headline: Software Engineer | Java, React.js, AWS, Terraform
profile.summary: AWS certified - technical Full Stack Developer with 5+ years’ experience in various web technologies and frameworks designing and implementing web applications, optimizing databases, and automating testing and report processes. Proven track record of contributing to the development of critical government projects, including a facility locator for SAMHSA, with a strong focus on code quality, security, and accessibility. Expertise in AWS Cloud Serverless architecture design, PostgreSQL database management, and modernizing technology stacks.

positions.description: Improve payment processing and risk detection

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led and championed multiple and varied software releases. Including WAF tuning, enabling 5k RSA mfa device tokens, preparing deployment of communication system for over 60,000 corporate customers while avoiding the Spamhaus Block List, etc.
• Major contributor in the development of a serverless authentication and sso login app with a React S3 frontend and Golang Lambda backend from the ground up.
• Maintain existing apps through regular rehydrations, security patches, blue/green deployments, cert renewals, monitoring, compliance activities, etc.
• Iterative improvements on CI/CD pipelines, application features, failover resiliency, documentation, application testing and monitoring tools
• Mentored young students in Capital One's Coders training program: www.capitalone.com/coders/
• Provided SSO integration with our IdP for ICS/DCP
• AWS Solutions Architect Associate (SAA) Certification

positions.title: Java Developer - Web
positions.description:
• Contributed to delivery of webapps such as a facility locator for the substance abuse and mental health services administration (SAMHSA) under the Department of Health and Human Services to help people find the right place to get treatment.
• Contributed to full-stack web applications using Java, Play Framework, PostgreSQL, Nuxt.js, Vue.js, React-Redux, R, LaTeX, Django, etc.
• Contributed in the development of automated testing suites with Python & Selenium, JUnit, and Jest. Also helped integrate these tests into GitLab CI/CD pipelines (along with other checks like ESLint)
• Contributed to updating code bases to adapt different technologies and major version updates (i.e., self-hosted to AWS, jQuery to Vue.js, Play 1 to Play 2, etc.)
• Implemented language internationalization (i18n), broadening application accessibility for a diverse audience.
▪ Revamped the frontend codebase to integrate keyboard input navigation as well as providing easily understood screen-reader audio output for blind users through a commitment to inclusive design and enhanced usability
